title: Tie Players
description: This datapack allows you to tie players (or mannequins) with a lead, and to untie them with a sword. No resource pack required!
body:
# Tie Players
This datapack adds the ability to tie any players with a lead

**No resource pack required!**

![Preview](https://i.imgur.com/HUroGQb.gif)

## How to tie a player
- To tie a player, simply hold a lead near a player, and to untie it, use a sword.
- The lead used to tie a player will be cleared from your inventory
- Tied players can't move at all and can't use their hands
- The player must have a health inferior to 4 (2 hearts) to be tied

_A message in-game will appear to every new player explaining briefly how to tie a player_

### Known issue
- The rope is following the head movement instead of the body movement
